sources.title: OpenAI 獲得 110 億美元的融資，但必須爭取牙醫來獲得更多資金 / OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 獲得 110 億美元的融資，但必須爭取牙醫來獲得更多資金

sources.summary: OpenAI has secured $11 billion in fresh capital, the first tranche of a round that values the company at $1.25 trillion. The full round could swell to $20 billion. That OpenAI is already turning to wealthy private investors hints at a saturating AI capital market and growing investor caution. The article OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 已獲得 110 億美元的新資金，這是該輪融資的第一筆資金，該輪融資對該公司的估值達到了 1.25 兆美元。整輪融資規模可能擴大至 200 億美元。OpenAI 已經轉向尋求富裕的私人投資者，這暗示了人工智慧資本市場已經趨於飽和，且投資者的謹慎態度正在增加。

sources.title: 九個 AI 代理嘗試對美國國家實驗室的開放式問題進行自主研究，結果沒有任何一個達到專家的標準 / Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar
sources.title_zh: 九個 AI 代理嘗試對美國國家實驗室的開放式問題進行自主研究，結果沒有任何一個達到專家的標準
sources.title_en: Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar
sources.title_original: Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar
sources.summary: The "Into the Unknown" benchmark tasks nine AI agents with tackling open research questions from U.S. national laboratories. None of the 135 submissions meets all requirements. A total of 114 papers fail the integrity check, with agents claiming to have conducted experiments that never took place. GPT-6 Astra performs best but still doesn't meet the experts' standards. The article Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 「未知領域」（Into the Unknown）基準測試指派九個 AI 代理來解決來自美國國家實驗室的開放式研究問題。在 135 份提交的成果中，沒有任何一份符合所有要求。共有 114 篇論文未通過完整性檢查，代理聲稱進行了從未發生過的實驗。GPT-6 Astra 的表現最佳，但仍未達到專家的標準。

sources.summary: Nous Research retrained Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to produce Arete-27B, largely stripping out its pro-Chinese bias. The propaganda rate dropped from 22 percent to less than one percent, while general capabilities remained intact in tests. The method relied on 53 million tokens of supervised fine-tuning. The political bias is "applied late, it is applied thin," the team writes. The article State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Nous Research 重新訓練了 阿里巴巴的 Qwen3.8-27B 以推出 Arete-27B，在很大程度上剝離了其親中國的偏見。宣傳比率從百分之二十二降至不到百分之一，而通用能力在測試中保持完整。該方法依賴於五千三百年萬個 token 的監督式微調。該團隊寫道，政治偏見是「在後期應用，且應用得很薄弱」。

sources.title: Google's 人工智慧能從一般智慧手錶中偵測高血壓，且無需壓脈帶 / Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
sources.title_zh: Google's 人工智慧能從一般智慧手錶中偵測高血壓，且無需壓脈帶
sources.title_en: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
sources.title_original: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
sources.summary: Google Research built an AI that spots signs of high blood pressure using only the pulse and motion sensors in a standard smartwatch, no cuff needed. In a 196-person study, its 65.8 percent detection rate beat the traditional in-office measurement. The method is already live in the Google Health app, though it doesn't replace a formal diagnosis. The article Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google Research 開發出了一款人工智慧，僅需透過標準智慧手錶中的脈搏與動作感測器就能偵測高血壓跡象，不需要使用壓脈帶。在一項 196 人的研究中，其 65.8% 的檢測率超越了傳統的診所測量方式。該方法已在 Google Health 應用程式中上線，儘管它無法取代正式診斷。

stories.title: METR 發現 Anthropic 可能早在 7 月就已跨越了自身的 AI 加速警告閾值 / METR finds Anthropic may have crossed its own AI acceleration warning threshold back in July

sources.title: METR 發現 Anthropic 可能早在 7 月就已跨越了自身的 AI 加速警告閾值 / METR finds Anthropic may have crossed its own AI acceleration warning threshold back in July
sources.title_zh: METR 發現 Anthropic 可能早在 7 月就已跨越了自身的 AI 加速警告閾值
sources.title_en: METR finds Anthropic may have crossed its own AI acceleration warning threshold back in July
sources.title_original: METR finds Anthropic may have crossed its own AI acceleration warning threshold back in July
sources.summary: Nonprofit METR spent eleven weeks auditing Anthropic's internal research data and concluded that the pace of model development has roughly doubled, with about 80 percent of the speedup driven by AI-assisted research. Anthropic redacted the most informative evidence, though, which means the public has to rely on METR's judgment "much more than would be ideal." There are also skeptical voices inside the company. The article METR finds Anthropic may have crossed its own AI acceleration warning threshold back in July appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 非營利組織 METR 花了 11 週的時間審查 Anthropic's 的內部研究數據，並得出結論認為，模型開發的速度大約已經加倍，其中約 80% 的速度提升是由 AI 輔助研究所帶動。不過，Anthropic 塗黑了最具資訊價值的證據，這意味著大眾必須「比理想狀態下更多地」依賴 METR 的判斷。公司內部也存在著懷疑的聲音。

sources.summary: Ricursive Intelligence is releasing Ripple-65B Preview, a 65-billion-parameter open-weight language model that the company says achieves the top score among open-source U.S. models on the TerminalBench 2.1 coding benchmark at a total R&D cost of $32 million. On other benchmarks, however, Ripple falls behind the likewise newly released western open model Inkling 2 Small. The article Ripple-65B Preview delivers strong agentic coding results as a fully Apache 2.0 open US model appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Ricursive Intelligence 正在發布 Ripple-65B Preview，這是一個擁有 650 億個參數的開源權重語言模型，該公司表示，該模型在 TerminalBench 2.1 編碼基準測試中獲得了美國開源模型的最高分，總研發成本為 3200 萬美元。然而，在其他基準測試中，Ripple 的表現則落後於同樣新發布的西方開源模型 Inkling 2 Small。

stories.title: Buoyant 發布 Kinference：用於 Kubernetes 與 vLLM 的開源推論控制平面 / Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM

sources.title: Buoyant 發布 Kinference：用於 Kubernetes 與 vLLM 的開源推論控制平面 / Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM
sources.title_zh: Buoyant 發布 Kinference：用於 Kubernetes 與 vLLM 的開源推論控制平面
sources.title_en: Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM
sources.title_original: Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM
sources.summary: Buoyant has released Kinference, an Apache 2.0 inference control plane for vLLM on Kubernetes. It adds declarative routing policies, KV-cache-aware load balancing and per-tenant metrics, and cut median TTFT 95% in Buoyant’s own benchmark. The post Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Buoyant 推出了 Kinference，這是一個針對 Kubernetes 上 vLLM 的 Apache 2.0 推論控制平面。它加入了宣告式路由策略、感知 KV 快取（KV-cache-aware）的負載平衡以及按租戶劃分的指標，並在 Buoyant 自身的效能測試中將中位數 TTFT 降低了 95%。

stories.title: 關於 AI 資料中心的所有最新動態 / All the latest updates on AI data centers

sources.title: 關於 AI 資料中心的所有最新動態 / All the latest updates on AI data centers
sources.title_zh: 關於 AI 資料中心的所有最新動態
sources.title_en: All the latest updates on AI data centers
sources.title_original: All the latest updates on AI data centers
sources.summary: Massive new data centers are the physical foundation for tech companies’ hopes and dreams for AI. But the rush to expand warehouses full of energy-hungry servers has also kicked up fights across the world over their impact on power grids, utility bills, nearby communities, and the environment. Data centers were a major bipartisan issue ahead […]
sources.summary_zh: 龐大的全新資料中心是科技公司對 AI 的希望與夢想的實體基礎。然而，擴建滿是耗能伺服器的倉庫的這股熱潮，也在世界各地引發了關於其對電網、公用事業帳單、鄰近社區以及環境之影響的爭議。資料中心在 […] 之前曾是重要的跨黨派議題。

sources.summary: Meta will now allow you to build customized, app-like experiences within Muse. The new feature, called "spaces," allows its AI assistant to build things like a shopping hub, school dashboard, music tracker, trivia game, and more, which you can interact with directly in the Muse app. Meta says you can create a new space by […]
sources.summary_zh: Meta 現在將允許你在 Muse 內建立自訂的應用程式化體驗。這項名為「spaces」的新功能可讓其 AI 助理建立購物中心、學校儀錶板、音樂追蹤器、冷知識遊戲等內容，供你在 Muse 應用程式中直接與之互動。Meta 表示，你可以透過 […] 建立一個新的 space。

sources.title_original: Perplexity now has its own always-on AI agent
sources.summary: Perplexity is launching "Teammates," always-on agents that work through ongoing projects on their own virtual machines. The feature requires the Max plan at $200 per month, well above similar offerings from OpenAI or Anthropic. The market for always-on agents is getting crowded. The article Perplexity now has its own always-on AI agent appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Perplexity 正在推出「Teammates」，這是一種常駐型代理程式，可在自己的虛擬機器上透過進行中的專案進行工作。此功能需要每月 $200 美元的 Max 方案，遠高於 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 的類似產品。常駐型代理程式的市場正變得擁擠。

sources.title: Google's 人工智慧能從一般智慧手錶中偵測高血壓，且無需壓脈帶 / Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
sources.title_zh: Google's 人工智慧能從一般智慧手錶中偵測高血壓，且無需壓脈帶
sources.title_en: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
sources.title_original: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
sources.summary: Google Research built an AI that spots signs of high blood pressure using only the pulse and motion sensors in a standard smartwatch, no cuff needed. In a 196-person study, its 65.8 percent detection rate beat the traditional in-office measurement. The method is already live in the Google Health app, though it doesn't replace a formal diagnosis. The article Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google Research 開發出了一款人工智慧，僅需透過標準智慧手錶中的脈搏與動作感測器就能偵測高血壓跡象，不需要使用壓脈帶。在一項 196 人的研究中，其 65.8% 的檢測率超越了傳統的診所測量方式。該方法已在 Google Health 應用程式中上線，儘管它無法取代正式診斷。

sources.title: 部分中國人工智慧模型中的國家宣傳僅僅是微調即可剝離的「薄薄一層」 / State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
sources.title_zh: 部分中國人工智慧模型中的國家宣傳僅僅是微調即可剝離的「薄薄一層」
sources.title_en: State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
sources.title_original: State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
sources.summary: Nous Research retrained Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to produce Arete-27B, largely stripping out its pro-Chinese bias. The propaganda rate dropped from 22 percent to less than one percent, while general capabilities remained intact in tests. The method relied on 53 million tokens of supervised fine-tuning. The political bias is "applied late, it is applied thin," the team writes. The article State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Nous Research 重新訓練了 阿里巴巴的 Qwen3.8-27B 以推出 Arete-27B，在很大程度上剝離了其親中國的偏見。宣傳比率從百分之二十二降至不到百分之一，而通用能力在測試中保持完整。該方法依賴於五千三百年萬個 token 的監督式微調。該團隊寫道，政治偏見是「在後期應用，且應用得很薄弱」。

events.news_summary: Ricursive Intelligence 發布 Ripple-65B Preview，宣稱在 TerminalBench 2.1 編碼基準中取得美國開源模型最高分，研發成本為 3200 萬美元。

sources.title: 作為完全採用 Apache 2.0 的美國開源模型，Ripple-65B Preview 提供了強大的代理式編碼成果 / Ripple-65B Preview delivers strong agentic coding results as a fully Apache 2.0 open US model
sources.title_zh: 作為完全採用 Apache 2.0 的美國開源模型，Ripple-65B Preview 提供了強大的代理式編碼成果
sources.title_en: Ripple-65B Preview delivers strong agentic coding results as a fully Apache 2.0 open US model
sources.title_original: Ripple-65B Preview delivers strong agentic coding results as a fully Apache 2.0 open US model
sources.summary: Ricursive Intelligence is releasing Ripple-65B Preview, a 65-billion-parameter open-weight language model that the company says achieves the top score among open-source U.S. models on the TerminalBench 2.1 coding benchmark at a total R&D cost of $32 million. On other benchmarks, however, Ripple falls behind the likewise newly released western open model Inkling 2 Small. The article Ripple-65B Preview delivers strong agentic coding results as a fully Apache 2.0 open US model appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Ricursive Intelligence 正在發布 Ripple-65B Preview，這是一個擁有 650 億個參數的開源權重語言模型，該公司表示，該模型在 TerminalBench 2.1 編碼基準測試中獲得了美國開源模型的最高分，總研發成本為 3200 萬美元。然而，在其他基準測試中，Ripple 的表現則落後於同樣新發布的西方開源模型 Inkling 2 Small。

sources.title: METR 發現 Anthropic 可能早在 7 月就已跨越了自身的 AI 加速警告閾值 / METR finds Anthropic may have crossed its own AI acceleration warning threshold back in July
sources.title_zh: METR 發現 Anthropic 可能早在 7 月就已跨越了自身的 AI 加速警告閾值
sources.title_en: METR finds Anthropic may have crossed its own AI acceleration warning threshold back in July
sources.title_original: METR finds Anthropic may have crossed its own AI acceleration warning threshold back in July
sources.summary: Nonprofit METR spent eleven weeks auditing Anthropic's internal research data and concluded that the pace of model development has roughly doubled, with about 80 percent of the speedup driven by AI-assisted research. Anthropic redacted the most informative evidence, though, which means the public has to rely on METR's judgment "much more than would be ideal." There are also skeptical voices inside the company. The article METR finds Anthropic may have crossed its own AI acceleration warning threshold back in July appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 非營利組織 METR 花了 11 週的時間審查 Anthropic's 的內部研究數據，並得出結論認為，模型開發的速度大約已經加倍，其中約 80% 的速度提升是由 AI 輔助研究所帶動。不過，Anthropic 塗黑了最具資訊價值的證據，這意味著大眾必須「比理想狀態下更多地」依賴 METR 的判斷。公司內部也存在著懷疑的聲音。

events.news_summary: Buoyant發布Apache 2.0授權的Kinference，為Kubernetes上的vLLM提供推論控制平面，其自測顯示中位TTFT降低95%。

sources.title: Buoyant 發布 Kinference：用於 Kubernetes 與 vLLM 的開源推論控制平面 / Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM
sources.title_zh: Buoyant 發布 Kinference：用於 Kubernetes 與 vLLM 的開源推論控制平面
sources.title_en: Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM
sources.title_original: Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM
sources.summary: Buoyant has released Kinference, an Apache 2.0 inference control plane for vLLM on Kubernetes. It adds declarative routing policies, KV-cache-aware load balancing and per-tenant metrics, and cut median TTFT 95% in Buoyant’s own benchmark. The post Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Buoyant 推出了 Kinference，這是一個針對 Kubernetes 上 vLLM 的 Apache 2.0 推論控制平面。它加入了宣告式路由策略、感知 KV 快取（KV-cache-aware）的負載平衡以及按租戶劃分的指標，並在 Buoyant 自身的效能測試中將中位數 TTFT 降低了 95%。

events.news_summary: 「Into the Unknown」基準測試中，九個AI代理處理美國國家實驗室開放研究問題，135份提交均未達標，其中114份未通過誠實性檢查。

sources.title: 九個 AI 代理嘗試對美國國家實驗室的開放式問題進行自主研究，結果沒有任何一個達到專家的標準 / Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar
sources.title_zh: 九個 AI 代理嘗試對美國國家實驗室的開放式問題進行自主研究，結果沒有任何一個達到專家的標準
sources.title_en: Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar
sources.title_original: Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar
sources.summary: The "Into the Unknown" benchmark tasks nine AI agents with tackling open research questions from U.S. national laboratories. None of the 135 submissions meets all requirements. A total of 114 papers fail the integrity check, with agents claiming to have conducted experiments that never took place. GPT-6 Astra performs best but still doesn't meet the experts' standards. The article Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 「未知領域」（Into the Unknown）基準測試指派九個 AI 代理來解決來自美國國家實驗室的開放式研究問題。在 135 份提交的成果中，沒有任何一份符合所有要求。共有 114 篇論文未通過完整性檢查，代理聲稱進行了從未發生過的實驗。GPT-6 Astra 的表現最佳，但仍未達到專家的標準。

None of the 135 submissions meets all requirements. A total of 114 papers fail the integrity check, with agents claiming to have conducted experiments that never took place. GPT-6 Astra performs best but still doesn't meet the experts' standards. A total of 114 papers fail the integrity check, with agents claiming to have conducted experiments that never took place. GPT-6 Astra performs best but still doesn't meet the experts' standards. The article Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.title: Frontier Radar #5: 如果 AGI 如此接近，為什麼大家都想離開？新實驗室與他們的賭注 / Frontier Radar #5: If AGI is so close, why is everyone leaving? The neolabs and their bets
sources.title_zh: Frontier Radar #5: 如果 AGI 如此接近，為什麼大家都想離開？新實驗室與他們的賭注
sources.title_en: Frontier Radar #5: If AGI is so close, why is everyone leaving? The neolabs and their bets
sources.title_original: Frontier Radar #5: If AGI is so close, why is everyone leaving? The neolabs and their bets
sources.summary: OpenAI is talking about the AGI era, and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says AGI has arrived. At the same time, co-creators of today's models are leaving OpenAI, Google DeepMind, and Meta to start their own labs, raising billions with no product to show. Why? They're betting that the current recipe alone won't be enough. We've sorted 45 neolabs by their research bets, mapped the limitations of today's AI they're trying to overcome, looked at what's already visible from their work, and explain why Nvidia always wins. The article Frontier Radar #5: If AGI is so close, why is everyone leaving? The neolabs and their bets appeared first on The Decoder .

source_material.title: Frontier Radar #5: If AGI is so close, why is everyone leaving? The neolabs and their bets
source_material.summary: OpenAI is talking about the AGI era, and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says AGI has arrived. At the same time, co-creators of today's models are leaving OpenAI, Google DeepMind, and Meta to start their own labs, raising billions with no product to show. Why? They're betting that the current recipe alone won't be enough. sources.title: OpenAI 獲得 110 億美元的融資，但必須爭取牙醫來獲得更多資金 / OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 獲得 110 億美元的融資，但必須爭取牙醫來獲得更多資金
sources.title_en: OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital
sources.title_original: OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital
sources.summary: OpenAI has secured $11 billion in fresh capital, the first tranche of a round that values the company at $1.25 trillion. The full round could swell to $20 billion. That OpenAI is already turning to wealthy private investors hints at a saturating AI capital market and growing investor caution. The article OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 已獲得 110 億美元的新資金，這是該輪融資的第一筆資金，該輪融資對該公司的估值達到了 1.25 兆美元。整輪融資規模可能擴大至 200 億美元。OpenAI 已經轉向尋求富裕的私人投資者，這暗示了人工智慧資本市場已經趨於飽和，且投資者的謹慎態度正在增加。
